title: Torch Counter
description: A mod that always keeps track on your total amount of torches.
body: A torch‑tracking mod that constantly monitors your total number of torches across your entire inventory, updating in real time as you craft, pick up, place, or consume them. Instead of manually checking stacks, the mod gives you a clear, always‑visible counter, making resource management smoother during mining trips, cave exploration, or speedrunning.
